Done — solved in a single plan execution, no failures.

**Plan** (`out/T3/plan.yaml`): delete the 48 buffers via an exact alternation `attention\.(bias|masked_bias|rotary_emb\.inv_freq)` (so the real `dense.bias`/`query_key_value.bias` parameters survive) → `cast_` everything to float32 → `cast_` the 64 projection matrices to bfloat16 → asserts → sharded output at `shard: 256MB`.

**Verified output**: 196 tensors, 64 BF16 / 132 F32, 9 shards + `model.safetensors.index.json`; `gpt_neox.embed_in.weight` and `embed_out.weight` (412 MB each in fp32) each alone in their own shard, every other shard ≤ 268,435,456 bytes of tensor data.

Required checks are in the plan as asserts, including a negative-lookahead `dtype: float32` over the complement of the projection pattern to pin "exactly 64 bfloat16". Self-report written to `out/T3/REPORT.md`.
